extracted.name: Chicken and Egg Chowmin (Nepali Style)
extracted.description: Great recipe for Chicken and Egg Chowmin (Nepali Style).
ingredient_lines: Garlic and All purpose seasoning salt. (Optional)
instruction_lines: Make thin pieces of Capsicum, Onions, Spring Onions, Cabbage, Green Chillies
Gently stir fry the onions by adding tumeric powder, dont overcook it
Then add spring onions and chillies and do the same
Add some garlic salt or normal salt and red chilli powder and stir it gently.
Thin pasta strings will be good, just add some salt and oil during boiling so they won't stick with eachother and wash it gently with cold water.
Add pasta and soy sauce as much as you feel like adding and mix it well
This ladle will be easier to mix it well.
Then serve as you like it.
I added some chicken as well. Can add some coriander on top. I didn't cz it was finished 🙂
